description: This file defines a Java class named ContactForm, which models a contact form with fields for name, email, subject, comment, and CAPTCHA response/challenge fields. It includes annotations for validation constraints on the fields.

classes.name: ContactForm
classes.description: A POJO representing the contact form data with validation annotations on fields.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name entered in the contact form.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name in the contact form.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address entered in the contact form.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address in the contact form.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment entered in the contact form.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment in the contact form.

methods.name: getCaptchaResponseField
methods.description: Returns the CAPTCHA response field value.

methods.name: setCaptchaResponseField
methods.description: Sets the CAPTCHA response field value.

methods.name: getCaptchaChallengeField
methods.description: Returns the CAPTCHA challenge field value.

methods.name: setCaptchaChallengeField
methods.description: Sets the CAPTCHA challenge field value.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the contact form.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets the subject of the contact form.
